items.t: Marvell Scales Connectivity to Address AI Infrastructure's Next Bottleneck at Supercomputing 2026
items.sum: SANTA CLARA, Calif., November 13, 2026--Marvell Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MRVL), a leader in data infrastructure semiconductor solutions, today announced its participation in Supercomputing 2026 (SC26), the International Conference for High-performance Computing (HPC), Networking, Storage and Analysis, taking place November 15-20 at the McCormick Place convention center in Chicago.
